mapper.select: select S.STUDENT_NO -- 객체에 안 담는 식별용 ,S.NAME ,S.GRADE ,S.SEMESTER ,S.TRACK ,SCH.NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME ,T.MAJOR ,T.UNIV ,T.RANKING from STUDENT S left join SCHOOL SCH on (S.SCHOOL_CODE = SCH.SCHOOL_CODE) left join TARGET_INFO T on (S.STUDENT_NO = T.STUDENT_NO) where S.STUDENT_NO = #{studentNo} order by T.RANKING ASC

select S.STUDENT_NO -- 객체에 안 담는 식별용 ,S.NAME ,S.GRADE ,S.SEMESTER ,S.TRACK ,SCH.NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME ,T.MAJOR ,T.UNIV ,T.RANKING from STUDENT S left join TARGET_INFO T on (S.STUDENT_NO = T.STUDENT_NO) left join SCHOOL SCH on (SCH.SCHOOL_CODE = S.SCHOOL_CODE) where S.STUDENT_NO = #{studentNo} order by T.RANKING ASC
